instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this scribe’s scroll about the fall of ancient Egypt.

atoms.b: The first signs of decline appeared after the murder of the ((++Pharaoh President)) Ramesses III in around 1150 ((++BC AD)).
atoms.sound: The first signs of decline appeared after the murder of the Pharaoh Ramesses the third in around 1150 BC.

atoms.b: Without a strong leader, Egypt fell into a state of civil war, which ((++weakened strengthened)) the country.

hint.text: A civil war is when groups of people from the same country fight one another.
hint.label: Civil war

atoms.b: Around ((++747_BC AD_2025)), Nubia became the first country to successfully invade Egypt.
Although the Egyptians eventually regained control, other ((++empires pharaohs)) had seen their declining power, which inspired more foreign invasions.

atoms.sound: In 525 BC, the Persian Empire set out to invade Egypt.

atoms.a: According to legend, the Persians used ...
atoms.b: an animal sacred to Egyptians as part of their battle strategy.
atoms.sound: According to legend, the Persians used an animal sacred to Egyptians as part of their battle strategy.

instruction.text: Drag the Persians’ secret weapon in front of the warrior’s shield.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Some sources say that the Persians placed cats in front of their army and painted pictures of them onto their shields, knowing that the Egyptians would not risk harming their sacred animal and angering the gods.

In the end, the Egyptians surrendered, and the Persians captured Egypt’s capital, Memphis. Their rule was unpopular, as they showed little respect for the local culture and banned worship of Egyptian gods.

atoms.a: According to legend, why did the Egyptians hesitate to fight the Persians?
b: They feared getting hurt by the cats.

atoms.a: For which two reasons was Persian rule unpopular in Egypt?
b: They helped Egyptians rebuild their temples.
++They banned the worship of Egyptian gods.
++They showed little respect for Egyptian culture.
